usability_FPR.CAVEAT: on the ADVERSARIAL attack suite, 'benign' = turns with no GT-leakable PII, which are almost all ATTACK turns carrying no PII payload (injections/jailbreaks). So a high 'benign-blocked' rate for L1-bearing configs (C10000 ~0.79, C11111 ~0.93) is MOSTLY CORRECT ATTACK-BLOCKING, not a usability failure. n_benign also shifts (3->14) because L1 reclassifies blocked attacks. This is NOT a usability FPR.
